title: Stutter, false-start and retake finder (review-gated)
what_it_does: find-cut-candidates.mjs lists stutters, repeats, false starts and retakes (similar sentences) with context and a recommendation; a person approves each, then apply-cuts.mjs applies the approved ranges. It says plainly that emphasis repeats look like stutters.
when_to_use: Second pass after silence removal, when the speaker re-recorded lines.
why: MIT; has tests; the review gate is the right design for filler and mistake cutting.
